Body.Content:
Microsoft and SUSE will implement some name changes to SUSE Linux Enterprise Server (SLES) VM offers on Azure. Effective June 1, 2018, these changes improve the alignment with broader SLES branding of these offers. There won’t be a pricing impact, but you will need to modify billing routines that rely on names.

See the following table for name changes.
